items.title: McNeal Breaux Interview, 1958-11-24
items.q: We call him Skiz, little Gishaw.

ctx.x: No, that's his brother. Yeah, Preston lived right down on St. Philip Street. No, that's Skiz's brother. We call him Skiz, little Gishaw. Alfred plays alto. Skiz plays bass. You know the bass player? No, I don't know. He's one of them.
I just heard of Alfred Bill. You know?
